body.text: Handler's Note

This is Gotō's own report, not a reporter's account. It's a re-analysis of 49 and 50; Gotō is both the recorder and the one being analysed. The family history and suicide passages in the original carry his inferences, so read it keeping 'inference' and 'fact' apart.
One: Classifying People
Gotō: one, a cheap substitute for hard drugs; two, recreation; three, depression and mental illness.
Jing: what are two and three?
Gotō: one is a cheap substitute for hard drugs, two is recreation, three is depression and mental illness. You're definitely three.
Jing: hahaha definitely.
Gotō: I only want to serve the third kind too.
Jing: true, the ones who use it to play, to have fun — what kind of trashy little show-off is that. Who takes medicine for no reason.
Gotō: wwwwww that's what I think too. Which is why I really don't serve the second kind.
Two: Jing
Jing: then can I tell teacher a story about my father's mental illness wrecking the family? Let teacher infer what he's like.
Gotō: ... (analysis: machismo, control, delusion, cutting off power and water, taking the money and leaving.)
Gotō: to keep from becoming your father, you've made yourself very small, avoiding taking up anyone's place...
Jing: true. When I was little, from 0 to 4, my dad was often away, and I was always with my mom.
[Handler's note: this is Gotō's inference, not a diagnosis.]

Jing: he's a classmate I've known since second grade... he's the first person I liked. He comforted me, soothed me, talked me through things... then I confessed to him, and he just stayed silent and smiled gently.
Jing: and now he has another girlfriend and is colder to me than before. Is it just that he doesn't like me that much?
Jing: by the time you see these messages I'll already be at Betelgeuse... executing tonight.
Jing: ███, ████ speeds up unconsciousness and strengthens the toxicity, ████ put into capsules and swallowed, and I can be free.
[Handler's note: the method has been blacked out.]
Jing: my family, so much mental illness, I really wish I could have a good warm family... if I still remember you in my next life, can I come find you.
Jing: writing the note tonight, you'll be the first to read it.
Three: Ayaka
Ayaka: no.
Ayaka: it hurts.
[A photo: Ayaka's blood from self-harm with a razor blade, twenty-odd cuts, a great deal of blood.]
Ayaka: there's nowhere left to cut...
Ayaka: serves me right.
Ayaka: did I jump?
Staff: no.
[Handler's note: the photo was not opened; the method is not expanded.]
Four: The Afterglow Theory
Gotō: I believe the afterglow can intercept people who want to kill themselves.
Gotō: even after the afterglow, my mood was very, very good. After that, to figure out what triggers the afterglow, I started testing drugs constantly.
Jing: god, why is the afterglow so hard to trigger?
Gotō: so the afterglow exists like something out of myth.

Jing: that afterglow was like a god giving Teacher Pochi his one and only blessing, and teacher is like Prometheus wanting to bring that flame down to people. Let's bring that flame down to people together.
Jing: the afterglow has become my dream too.
Handler's Note

No. 51 is the hinge between 49 and 50. It puts three people at one table, and it also exposes Gotō's own categories, theories and saviour narrative. The original contained a long stretch of psychoanalysis; this file keeps only the quotable lines and the context needed to read them.
